sources.quote: HD 173416, also named Xihe, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet in the northern constellation of Lyra.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 72 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,790 K, so 12.372 solar radii.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 173416"
sources.quote: It is located at a distance of approximately 433 light-years based on parallax measurements, but is drifting closer to the Sun with a radial velocity of −61 km/s.
